{{Top|leg}}
The '''Droid multi-spectral emitter''' was a highly destructive energy beam emitter that had been typically mounted on armored tanks and used to counter the opposing army's vehicles. The downside of this weapon was that the energy yield of the beam was high enough to blow out the emitter in only a few shots.

==Behind the scenes==
A droid must be at upgrade class 3 to be able to equip this item.

*''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''
